prompts.prompt: Production sprite atlas for VOICES, a cozy top-down pixel-art educational adventure. Warm earthy palette, dark clean pixel outlines, readable medium pixel clusters, consistent three-quarter top-down view, natural recognizable anatomy. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT alpha background, generous empty gutters, no text, labels, grid lines, logos or scenery behind sprites. Exactly 4 columns and 4 rows of equally sized cells. Each row is ONE species in four sequential walking animation frames left to right: planted, step one, passing, step two. SAME animal design, same scale, same right-facing profile and baseline in every frame; only legs/wing/limbs change. All animals friendly but anatomically credible, no clothes, no collars. Row1: hippopotamus, bulky gray body short legs. Row2: male African lion with mane and long tail. Row3: African savanna elephant with LARGE ears, trunk and tusks. Row4: Nile crocodile, long armored body, long snout, long tapered tail, short splayed legs.
